description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget 'InsuranceFragment' that displays static insurance information including policy coverage details, claim procedures, and a claim button. It matches the Kotlin 'InsuranceFragment' and is used for rendering the insurance screen within a Flutter application.

classes.name: InsuranceFragment
classes.description: A stateless widget that renders the insurance information screen with coverage details, claim procedures, and an action button.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the insurance screen, including header, coverage info, claim procedure, and a claim button.

methods.name: _buildCoverageItem
methods.description: Helper method to build individual coverage info rows with icon and text.
